treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Estonia and the Republic of Armenia for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2001)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 3. | Armenia | 02.10.1997 | 13.04.2001 | 11.12.2002 ( est/eng ) | 23.01.2003 | 01.01.2001 |
source_title: EE-AM Convention 2001 with Protocol (Riigi Teataja, est/eng)

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Estonia reserved MLI Art. 35(7)(a); its Art. 35(7)(b) notifications (25.11.2021, 01.06.2022) do not include this treaty, so the MLI (incl. PPT) has not yet effect.

notes: Interest exempt at source when beneficially owned by the other State's Government, local authorities, Central Bank, wholly-owned financial institution, or on government-guaranteed loans (Art. 11(3)). valid_from derived from Art. 28(2)(a) (1 January after EIF 23.01.2003 = 2004-01-01); the Estonian MoF table shows 'Effective from 01.01.2001', which conflicts with Art. 28 and looks like a table error. Protocol (2001) covers only Arts 4 and 7.
unverified: Estonian MoF table effective date 01.01.2001 vs Art. 28(2)(a) -> 2004-01-01
